message:
{
  "verdict": "escalate",
  "summary": "The run clip stays in place and its planted feet hold well within tolerance, but skin stretch fails at 4.56x (limit 1.0) where the tunic hem meets the left leg, and that is a skirt-weighting problem the motion revise actions can't fix.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "check": "motion",
      "severity": "major",
      "observation": "Edges stretch up to 5.56x their bind length at t=0.23 s. The worst edges are on LeftUpperLeg, where the inner tunic hem meets the trouser and boot top. Front view: two clusters, one at the inside of the right-side knee and boot top, one lower at the left shin where the hem joins the trouser. Back view: the same seam, one cluster mid-hem and one at the boot top. The stretch stays high (about 3.5-4.5x) over most of each stride, dropping only near foot contact (about 1.3x at 0.10 s and 0.63 s). So the hem-to-leg edges are being pulled between hem vertices weighted to the Hips and leg vertices that follow the thigh and shin. At strip scale the surface doesn't visibly tear. The tunic between the legs shows a vertical split and crease in the front view, but the red edges are drawn through the mesh, so these may be partly hidden interior edges.",
      "evidence": "assertion 'skin stretch (edge length vs bind pose)' 4.558 > 1.0; metrics.motion.edge_stretch_worst_bone LeftUpperLeg, p99 0.684; assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/04_stretch_detail.png; assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/03_plots.png (bottom-right edge stretch curve)"
    },
    {
      "check": "motion",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The Hips sway sideways (x) by up to 0.033 m and return to 0 by the last frame. This is ordinary run sway and well under the limit, with no drift or fling in either onion-skin view.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/02_onion_skin.png; 03_plots.png top-left; assertion 'root stays in place' 0.033 <= 0.15"
    }
  ],
  "escalation_reason": "The one failing assertion, skin stretch, comes from how the skirt is weighted: skirt_reweight grades the hem from Hips to the thighs, and the stretch sits on the hem-to-leg seam. It isn't from the clip's build options, so no library_change (in_place, a trim or another clip) would fix it, and reroll and refine_concept don't apply to a motion stage. At strip scale the images don't show a visible tear, and the worst edges are drawn through the mesh and may be interior. So it's unclear whether this is a visible defect at gameplay distance or a measurement dominated by hidden seam edges. Someone needs to check the skirt reweight region and its knee/hem boundary in scripts/blender_cleanup.py, look at the knee in a close render during the stride, and decide whether to fix the weights or accept the result.",
  "questions_answered": [
    "The body stays in place. The Hips move at most 0.033 m sideways and end at 0.00 m. Both onion-skin views show no drift, fling or slide.",
    "Yes. The planted feet drop to near zero ground-relative speed during contact (left around 0.03-0.13 s, right around 0.53-0.63 s). Foot slide p90 is 0.345 m/s against a 0.5 limit, and the root runs flat at the 5.0 m/s gameplay speed.",
    "The strip shows no broken pose: no limbs through the body, arms swing normally in front of and beside the torso, and no joints are twisted or collapsed. Stretched skin isn't visible at strip scale. The close-up puts it at the inner tunic hem and knee seam.",
    "Three pass (root travel 0.033/0.15, foot slide 0.345/0.5, bind deviation 1.206/1.8). Skin stretch fails at 4.558/1.0, on the hem-to-leg seam at the left knee and shin in 04_stretch_detail.png, and stays high through most of each stride in the 03_plots.png stretch curve."
  ],
  "images_seen": [
    "assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/01_frame_strip.png",
    "assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/02_onion_skin.png",
    "assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/03_plots.png",
    "assets/manifests/player/judge/motion-run-1/04_stretch_detail.png"
  ]
}
